# Copilot instructions for Parlot

All guidance for AI agents working in this repository lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repository root. Read that file first and follow it.

Copilot coding agent, Copilot code review and VS Code read `AGENTS.md` directly. This file exists because
the Visual Studio, JetBrains, Xcode and Eclipse Copilot plugins still only look for
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` — it is a pointer, not a second copy. Record new guidance in `AGENTS.md`.
